description: BOKU University and SECURES research partners publish the routines used to generate SECURES-Met energy-weather data. Seven small source archives cover aggregation to NUTS regions, hydro-energy production, weighting, temporal disaggregation, wind-energy production, radiation calculation and shared utilities. The software deposit links its generated European dataset and states CC BY 4.0, with free access. The associated workflow supports historical and projected energy meteorology; spatial and temporal coverage in a new application would follow its input data and aggregation choices. The routines can help prepare climate-sensitive supply and demand inputs for model-pypsa using sources such as data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that the landing page does not provide a complete installation or function-reference guide. Individual archives and their numerical assumptions need inspection before adapting the workflow. The software packages were identified through metadata and were not downloaded or executed.
